eps_note: evaluator is deterministic over 200 episodes x 20 frames; 0.005 is 20 frames

directives.EXPLOIT: One focused change to the current world model.
directives.BOREDOM_SNAP: Stop tweaking the same component; try a different mechanism (memory, dynamics, learning), grounded in world-model literature (Exa) and checked against past.dev.
directives.PARADIGM_BREAKOUT: Change the approach family (e.g. explicit map memory or learned tabular dynamics from the public episode split).
directives.CONVERGED: Re-run the best model to confirm the score.
